verified_facts.text: Bowie House is at 3700 Camp Bowie Boulevard in Fort Worth's Cultural District, near the city's museums, Will Rogers Memorial Center and Dickies Arena.
verified_facts.excerpt: Bowie House is located at 3700 Camp Bowie Boulevard in Fort Worth’s Cultural District, near the city’s renowned museums, Will Rogers Memorial Center and Dickies Arena.

verified_facts.text: The Fort Worth Stockyards are approximately four miles from Bowie House.
verified_facts.excerpt: The Fort Worth Stockyards are approximately four miles away.

verified_facts.text: Bowie House is approximately 28 miles, or 35-40 minutes, from Dallas Fort Worth International Airport.
verified_facts.excerpt: Bowie House is approximately 28 miles, or 35-40 minutes, from Dallas Fort Worth International Airport.

verified_facts.text: Bowie House merges the classic Western personality of Texas with a decidedly modern feel.
verified_facts.excerpt: Bowie House merges the classic Western personality of Texas with a decidedly modern feel

verified_facts.text: Bowie House is filled with works of art personally collected by owner Jo Ellard.

verified_facts.text: Bowie House is owned by Jo Ellard, who breeds championship horses at her ranch outside Fort Worth.

verified_facts.text: The centerpiece of The Bar at Bowie House is a vintage bar Ellard sourced from an auction house in Waco, Texas.

verified_facts.text: The hotel offers a complimentary art walk showcasing the art collected by owner Jo Ellard.

verified_facts.text: Each Studio nods to Texas living with hat racks, boot benches, boot jacks and leather-wrapped furniture.
